claim_boundary: Internal fixture-backed validation for implemented+usable+validated maturity only; commercial-grade still requires external corpora, independent review, and trusted-tool diffs.

validated_items.title: SAM/SECURITY/SYSTEM account and permission deep parser
assertions: windows-account-lifecycle rows preserve user name, RID, UAC flags, SAM F/V candidate fields, group membership hints, inherited privilege context, source hashes, and #6 core_accuracy_gates.
windows-lsa-policy-location rows preserve secret metadata without decrypting or exposing protected values.
windows-privilege-assignment rows attribute high-risk privileges to assigned SID/principal hints.
blockers_kept: full native SAM F/V layout validation

validated_items.title: Amcache parser
assertions: amcache-entry rows preserve path, program name, publisher, SHA1, timestamp source, execution caveat, source hash, and #7 core_accuracy_gates.
amcache-hive native rows preserve bounded path/hash string pivots and keep native schema decode blockers explicit.

validated_items.title: ShimCache/AppCompatCache parser
assertions: shimcache-entry rows preserve path/timestamp candidates, source order, OS-layout warning, not-proof-of-execution wording, and #8 core_accuracy_gates.
blockers_kept: native AppCompatCache binary layout decoding across Windows versions

validated_items.title: BAM/DAM execution parser
assertions: bam-entry rows preserve SID, device path, FILETIME timestamp, CurrentControlSet attribution, execution semantics warning, and #9 core_accuracy_gates.
blockers_kept: native SYSTEM hive BAM/DAM binary value interpretation

srum-database-file, srum-table-candidate, and srum-row-candidate rows preserve ESE header validation, table markers, row string candidates, counter/timestamp candidates, source hashes, and #10 core_accuracy_gates.
